question: Should this broad contributor branch continue, or should Signal quote work be consolidated into the maintainer-owned native quote path plus a narrow BodyForAgent fix?
rationale: The branch overlaps an open maintainer-labeled draft with live Signal proof while introducing public SDK and shared delivery semantics that require product/API ownership rather than a routine contributor repair.

options.title: Consolidate around maintainer Signal quote work
options.body: Pause or close this branch in favor of the maintainer-owned native Signal quote PR and a narrow `BodyForAgent` fix that avoids public SDK null suppression.

options.title: Continue this branch after major narrowing
options.body: Ask the author to remove the public SDK null contract, keep suppression inside the Signal owner boundary, fix `BodyForAgent`, rebase, and add live Signal proof.

options.title: Approve a broader SDK/API direction
options.body: Explicitly bless `null` reply suppression as a public plugin SDK contract and require compatibility docs/tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Consolidate around maintainer Signal quote work
recommendation.body: Pause or close this branch in favor of the maintainer-owned native Signal quote PR and a narrow `BodyForAgent` fix that avoids public SDK null suppression.
